text:
Which statement about ultrasound is correct?
A
Ultrasound must have greater amplitude than audible sound.
B
Ultrasound must have greater frequency than audible sound.
C
Ultrasound must have lower amplitude than audible sound.
D
Ultrasound must have lower frequency than audible sound.

options.label: A
options.text: Ultrasound must have greater amplitude than audible sound.

options.label: B
options.text: Ultrasound must have greater frequency than audible sound.

options.label: C
options.text: Ultrasound must have lower amplitude than audible sound.

options.label: D
options.text: Ultrasound must have lower frequency than audible sound.
